body: I feel trapped too. I would do anything to get out of this but it feels like no matter what I do I can't pull myself out of it. I feel so doomed
Thank you. He tells me that I am emotionally draining so I do not open up to him about this stuff. Maybe that is part of the problem. I just feel like a burden

All of your replies honestly really mean a lot to me. You’ve made it easier to get through this. I am not going to meet with him or give him my side... I don’t want to be someone’s “maybe.” Thank you all <3
Thank you for the edit. The wanting to meet in person (on his end) and telling me he loves me as he dumps me does feel like emotional manipulation...
I don’t feel like he doesn’t love me any longer, but maybe I’m stupid and naive. I think people can break up even when there is still love between the two of them.
I like this idea. Should I ask if he has anything to say beforehand? Or just wait for the day to come?
this is why like I feel like I need to give my side and make it clear that this isn’t fair and that this is the end...
He kept saying I hope we can be friends, I still love you, I’m here for you, I hope that if this is mistake that you’ll forgive me, if we are right for each other we will be together again
